Clear and conversational

Professional but friendly

Easy to understand

Trust-building

No marketing hype

Suitable for real users

LYNQED is a location-based marketplace for student communities

It connects buyers, vendors, and delivery personnel within the same campus or nearby area

Answer clearly:

No

LYNQED is operated under Liquid, which governs and maintains the platform

LYNQED is designed primarily for students and campus communities

Users sign up using basic personal information

Users may switch roles where allowed

Browse nearby vendors

Select products

Yes

Register as a vendor

Register as delivery personnel

No

Fees may depend on distance, delivery method, or order details

LYNQED follows strong data protection practices

Supabase is used for backend infrastructure

No

Refresh the app

Check internet connection

Contact support if issues persist

LYNQED is accessible via web and mobile-friendly experiences

Platform improvements are ongoing

Generate clean, readable FAQ content
